reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets have roughly doubled since August (E-03), and the majority (59%, 1785/3025) of disputed bills carry ACTUAL, non-estimated reads while no tariff change occurred this year (E-01, E-02). This points to a billing calculation error at the billing-import/calculation step (not estimate substitution from AMI or field-read failures, which can explain at most the 41% ESTIMATED-read share) as the dominant cause of the dispute surge.
